name: A Stain on the Company
source:
The fourth floor's off limits to most employees, but apparently someone missed the memo. You'd better go and find him, before something worse does.

[From [url=https://falselyprofound.itch.io/o2a2-2024]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
四楼对大部分员工都是禁区，可显然有人没收到通知。你最好赶紧去把他找出来，免得更糟的东西先找到他。

［摘自[url=https://falselyprofound.itch.io/o2a2-2024]itch.io[/url]］
